_readme: Extra shelves for places the crawl filed under their OSM primary tag only. OSM allows one primary tag, so a guesthouse that is also a coworking space reaches one shelf and is invisible on the other — Hub 53 sat under hotel/guesthouse while its coworking floor went unlisted. Entries here ADD cat/sub to an existing record by id; they never remove or argue with crawled facts (same discipline as names.json). Each entry names the source that attests the second identity, and that source is appended to the record's provenance.
